test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

If ‘C + M – S × K – T ÷ Q’, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: Q is the husband of T.
M is the father's mother of Q.
C is the mother’s brother of S.
S is the father of Q.

solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 -
 +
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Husband
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: ‘C + M – S × K – T ÷ Q’

It means: C is brother of M. M is mother of S. S is husband of K. K is mother of T. T is sister of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152472675b4a51f56ec63612c3f96407d55be233fb45d81e92840bae718ad639.png] 

Q is the husband of T → False (Because, T is Sister of Q, and T's gender is not defined).

M is the father's mother of Q → True

C is the mother’s brother of S → True

S is the father of Q → True

Thus, Q is the husband of T is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
